config.index: one IndexHNSWFlat per locale, METRIC_INNER_PRODUCT, saved float32 unit vectors
config.exact_control: Faiss IndexFlatIP using the identical stored vectors; singleton searches with complete cutoff-tie expansion and score/ascending-ID order; separately report agreement/numeric differences with saved Torch exact results
config.ann_ties: sort the 100 returned candidates by score then ascending ID; unvisited or excluded cutoff ties are approximation loss, not a global deterministic-tie guarantee
config.metrics: set agreement@100 with matched Faiss Flat exact control, known-Exact Recall@100, judgment coverage@10, and fixed c=60 RRF impact versus matched Flat hybrid and frozen Torch hybrid
config.selection: lowest efSearch with overall agreement >=0.95, every locale agreement >=0.90, and hybrid recall paired lower bound >=-0.005 overall plus mean loss <=0.005 per locale versus matched Flat hybrid; otherwise no candidate nominated
config.replay: persist one multithread-built graph per locale with hashes, then repeat singleton queries from fresh worker processes on the same graphs; all three timed passes and reload must reproduce rankings; do not claim bit-identical independent graph construction
config.measurement: separate build, index read, index bytes, per-locale query-worker peak RSS and warm singleton retrieval p50/p95/p99; timings include native search/tie handling/sorting but exclude encoding, HTTP, serialization and file writes; no concurrent/API QPS claim
config.scope: fixed float32 ANN tradeoff grid only, no post-result parameter sweep, int8, new encoding, training, serving or official test access

limits: Finite validation grid, incomplete human judgments and one frozen multithread-built graph per locale. Agreement is not human recall; coverage is not precision. Warm serial native timings exclude encoding, API, I/O serialization and concurrency. Worker RSS is per-locale, not all-index/whole-host residency. No independent graph rebuild identity, int8, test, production adoption or QPS claim.
